content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Office property REIT leasing workspace to corporate tenants; no sports team, ballpark events, or fan revenue."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Runs B2B trade shows selling booth space to exhibitors; shares event hosting but not fan-facing sports entertainment."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Casual seafood restaurants and package liquor stores with franchising; different business from owning a professional sports team."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Nevada casinos, hotels and tavern slot routes; gaming-driven business with high gaming regulation, unlike a baseball franchise."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Golf courses, hitting bays and mini golf venues; recreational play rather than a professional team with media rights."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Concert promotion and ticketing platform for artists; shares fans and sponsors but lacks team ownership and game-based economics."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Bowling centers selling lane time, food and party packages; consumer play venues, not a professional sports franchise."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Las Vegas casino resorts driven by gaming and lodging; different business despite shared entertainment and hospitality elements."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Movie theatres and hotels selling admissions and rooms; no live sports team, though it shares concessions and advertising."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Florida land development, residential lot sales, timber and resort hotels; real estate and forestry rather than sports entertainment."}]}
